say:2:1030402001:1.text: Boss, <hpy>I heard the grapes from Southville are selling like hotcakes. You don't want to miss this great opportunity!</hpy>
say:2:1030402001:1.source_cn: 老板，<hpy>听说南村的葡萄大卖，是个不可错过的商机...

say:3:1030402002:1.text:
Those grapes might be cursed.
Things are often more complicated than they appear.
say:3:1030402002:1.source_cn: 那葡萄或许受到了什么邪恶的诅咒，\n有些事情可不如表面...

say:4:1030402003:1.text:
Think about those buyers who have been reduced to nothing...
Integrity is important in business.
say:4:1030402003:1.source_cn: 想想那些倾家荡产的买家吧……\n做生意必须建立在诚信之上。

say:5:1030402004:1.text: <sad>When do you think we should add a few more helpers?</sad>
say:5:1030402004:1.source_cn: <sad>那您什么时候考虑加几个伙计？</sad>

say:6:1030402005:1.text: When I can afford to open a new branch.
say:6:1030402005:1.source_cn: 等我有钱开分店的时候。
